integrity: The exact cutoff is proved analytically from the focal paper's facet reduction and checked with exact rational arithmetic. The checker is supplementary and no finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the initial plateau for the specific polygonal plane X in Example 6; it does not compute the full intermediate profile, the companion plane Y threshold, or a general polygonal-space formula. An unindexed equivalent derivation remains possible because the focal preprint is recent.
title: Exact first-departure threshold of a polygonal approximate Birkhoff–James profile
